cuts.title: God Didn't Knock Down the Tower | The Confusion of Tongues, Genesis 11 (KJV) #shorts
cuts.description:
No lightning, no flood, not one brick struck: at Babel God quietly took away their words (Genesis 11:7, King James Version).

Watch the full story of Babel: https://youtu.be/KwFjnZ20yGA

cuts.title: Do We Really Need God? | Building the Tower of Babel, Genesis 11 (KJV) #shorts
cuts.description:
Terrace upon terrace, millions of bricks, one quiet question in every one of them, until the sky above Babel began to change (Genesis 11).

Watch the full story of Babel: https://youtu.be/KwFjnZ20yGA

Scripture: King James Version (public domain), Genesis 11.
Visuals: AI-generated scenes (GPT-image stills with camera motion). Narration: AI voice. Music: original, owned.
